source.name: Meta's Apps
source.subtitle: Custom builds and forks by OMetaVR
source.description: IPAs I build myself, served straight from each project's GitHub releases.

apps.name: Distra
apps.subtitle: Discord with Vendetta, Bunny/Revenge and Enmity plugin support
apps.localizedDescription:
Discord mod for iOS: runs Vendetta, Bunny/Revenge, Enmity and Aliucord plugins, ships ~100 built-in plugins (all off by default), icon packs and app icons. Includes crash-loop protection with an automatic safe mode.

Unofficial modification, not affiliated with Discord. Client mods break Discord's Terms of Service; use at your own risk.

apps.name: uYouEnhanced
apps.subtitle: YouTube with uYou, PiP, dislikes and more
apps.localizedDescription:
uYouEnhanced, the continuation of uYouPlus: YouTube with uYou (background playback, downloads, no ads) plus a bundle of tweaks like YouPiP, Return YouTube Dislikes, DontEatMyContent, YouQuality and YTUHD options.

Built automatically from upstream releases by github.com/OMetaVR/uYouPlus.

apps.name: EeveeSpotify
apps.subtitle: Spotify with Premium features, lyrics and Liquid Glass UI
apps.localizedDescription:
EeveeSpotify (Reincarnated), the continuation of whoeevee's EeveeSpotify: unlocks Premium-only playback features in Spotify, adds custom lyrics providers, and an optional iOS 26 Liquid Glass interface.

This is the sideload build (with zxPluginsInject) for SideStore, AltStore and LiveContainer. A TrollStore build and jailbreak .debs are on each release at github.com/OMetaVR/EeveeSpotify.

apps.name: Feather
apps.subtitle: On-device app signer and installer
apps.localizedDescription:
Feather is an on-device IPA signer and installer: import your certificates, add AltStore-style repos, and sign and install apps without a computer.

Built automatically from upstream releases by github.com/OMetaVR/feather.

apps.name: iTorrent
apps.subtitle: Torrent client for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
iTorrent is a full torrent client for iOS: magnet links, .torrent files, sequential download, background downloading, RSS and a built-in web server.

This build skips upstream's Firebase (no crash reporting or remote kill switch). Built by github.com/OMetaVR/iTorrent.

apps.name: Apollo Reborn
apps.subtitle: The Apollo Reddit client, revived
apps.localizedDescription:
Apollo Reborn brings back the Apollo Reddit client with your own Reddit API credentials, plus fixes and new features.

This is the standard build; Liquid Glass and no-extension variants are on each release at github.com/OMetaVR/Apollo-Reborn.

apps.name: TwitchAdBlock
apps.subtitle: Twitch without ads
apps.localizedDescription:
Twitch with TwitchAdBlock: blocks stream and VOD ads by proxying playlists, with extras from gunnerkidBT's maintained fork.

A no-extensions build and jailbreak .debs are on each release at github.com/OMetaVR/TwitchAdBlock.

apps.name: YTMusicUltimate
apps.subtitle: YouTube Music with Premium features
apps.localizedDescription:
YouTube Music with YTMusicUltimate: background playback, no ads, downloads and more.

Built by github.com/OMetaVR/YTMusicUltimate.

apps.name: SCMusicPlus
apps.subtitle: SoundCloud without ads
apps.localizedDescription:
SoundCloud with SCMusicPlus: removes audio and display ads and unlocks monetized tracks.

Built by github.com/OMetaVR/scmusicplus.

apps.name: BHTikTok
apps.subtitle: TikTok with downloads and no ads
apps.localizedDescription:
TikTok with BHTikTok: download videos and music, hide ads, and more.

Upstream hasn't been updated since 2023, so some features may not work on current TikTok. Built by github.com/OMetaVR/BHTikTok.

apps.name: BHTwitter
apps.subtitle: X with downloads and extra options
apps.localizedDescription:
X (Twitter) with BHTwitter: download videos, hide promoted posts, custom tab bar and many more options.

A TrollStore build and jailbreak .debs are on each release at github.com/OMetaVR/BHTwitter.
